definition_and_source: Case identifier. ALT_n = alternating, PAR_n = parallel. ALT_n and PAR_n are independent LHS samples and are NOT matched pairs
Geometry build used (converging CAD, Gate A verified)
GRAIL-CHT reduced-order conjugate model (not a 3-D CFD solver)
Incident solar irradiance on the aperture
Grading exponent of the hydraulic-diameter profile
Inlet hydraulic diameter (same for all cases)
Inlet cross-section area (same for all cases)
Water viscosity, Vogel correlation at ½(T_in+T_out); evaluated with the nx220 T_out (≤0.17 % difference)
Channel pressure drop: calibrated laminar integral (calibration factor from 3-D CFD); a model result, not a per-case 3-D CFD result
Thermal efficiency = Qu / (G_T × 0.528 m²), on INCIDENT irradiance
Standard deviation of plate temperature (uniformity metric)
(T_plate_mean)⁴ — NOTE: fourth power of the mean, not mean of T⁴
Net radiative heat flow plate→glazing (signed; negative = heat gain)
Net rear heat flow plate→ambient (signed; negative when plate below ambient)
(Q_solar − Qu)/(0.528 (T_plate_mean − T_amb)); undefined/unreliable when |T_plate_mean − T_amb| < 5 K
Heat conducted laterally through the bridges (≈0 in parallel flow by symmetry)
Outer iterations (max of the two plate grids)

**MODEL INPUT, NOT A PER-CASE CFD OUTPUT.** Fixed Nusselt closure applied to every case; derived once from grid-studied 3-D conjugate OpenFOAM CFD (4.48, GCI 2.1 %). Constant across all 300 cases by design (developed Nu was flow-independent in 3-D: 4.60 at 1.0, 2.49 and 4.5 g/s)
Provenance of nu_cfd: conjugate 3-D benchmark, H1-type thermal condition
Integer revision field; file is Rev 4.1 (see filename and change log)
